visualCharacteristics.purpose: live current weather and multi-day forecast for a destination; the whole widget is hidden when no weather data loads
traits: section heading 'Current weather in ...' above the data
today area: large temperature with weather icon and condition, optional humidity and wind
horizontal row of forecast days (weekday, date, icon, max/min) that scrolls sideways on small screens
today and forecast side by side from 900px

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, label | value. Rows: Title | Current weather in New York (rendered immediately as the heading); Location | NYC (IATA city or airport code, also 'New York (NYC)'; without a code the block stays hidden); Units | C or F (default C; the live answer carries both). Optional label rows with built-in English/German defaults chosen by the page language: Today label (Today / heute, only without day words in the answer), Forecast label (Forecast / Vorhersage, accessible name of the day list), Humidity label, Wind label, Wind with label (with / mit; defaults: the words of the live answer). Weather comes at runtime from GET /aircore/weather/{lang}/{code} (e.g. /aircore/weather/de/nyc, as the live AirCore pages load it) via lhFetch (lh-proxy or exactly this recorded request); if neither answers the whole block is hidden, like the source. Day names come with the answer (Today, Tomorrow, Friday). Unknown rows are ignored.

usage: AirCore destination pages (/lhg/{cc}/{lang}/dest/cy/{city}) in every locale: one weather block per destination, after the entry regulation cards.
reuseGuidance: Reuse unchanged for any destination; author only Title and Location. Request and response mapping sit at the top of weather.js (weatherRequest, mapLiveWeather for the live day list, mapWeather, weatherIconUrl).
